item.name: The Nightgown of Skalf

ownerLore.text: Skalf was a disreputable dwarven drifter who lived between 385 - 469.

item.description: Skalf was a disreputable dwarven drifter who lived between 385 - 469. Whoever last owned this nightgown took great care of it. Whoever found it did not. It was not meant to be carried alone. It no longer is.

item.name: The Tunic of Sakub

ownerLore.text: Sakub was a legendary dwarven masochist who lived between 340 - ???.

item.description: Sakub was a legendary dwarven masochist who lived between 340 - ???. The tunic has changed hands countless times. Its oldest recorded owner died more than a century ago. The Tunic of Sakub did not rest easy, and neither, it seems, does what he left behind. It borrows from your strength to keep its secrets intact.
